Run Cargo subcommands

Source: R/run-cargo.R
cargo.Rd

Call the cargo command line tool from R. This function delegates to processx::run("cargo") enabling calls such as cargo("test") or cargo("check").

Usage

cargo(
  args,
  echo = TRUE,
  error_on_status = TRUE,
  wd = NULL,
  env = NULL,
  parse_json = FALSE,
  error_call = rlang::caller_call(),
  ...
)

Arguments

args

character vector, the Cargo subcommand and flags to be executed.

echo

Default TRUE. Alogical scalar, whether to print standard output and error to the console.

error_on_status

Default TRUE. A logical scalar, whether to error on a non-zero exist status.

wd

character scalar, location of the Rust crate, (default is find_extendr_crate()).

env

character vector, environment variables of the child process.

parse_json

Default FALSE. A logical scalar, whether to parse JSON-structured standard output using jsonlite::parse_json() with simplifyDataFrame = TRUE.

error_call

Default rlang::caller_call(). The defused call with which the function running in the frame was invoked.

...

additional arguments passed to processx::run().

Value

Invisibly, a list with elements status, stdout, stderr, and timeout. See processx::run(). If parse_json = TRUE, result of parsing JSON-structured standard output.

Details

When wd = NULL (the default), the cargo command is called from the package's Rust crate's source. Otherwise, when wd = "/my/path", cargo will be run there.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# run cargo test from package root
cargo("test")
} # }
